## Hinge question · Example 3.11 {#l2-example-3-11 .compact .histogram-quiz}

```{=html}
<div class="paired-charts"><div><h3><span data-math="X">X</span></h3><div data-module="chart" data-set="histX" data-modes="frequency" data-static="true"></div></div><div><h3><span data-math="Y">Y</span></h3><div data-module="chart" data-set="histY" data-modes="frequency" data-static="true"></div></div></div>
```

```{=html}
<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="2" class="hinge">
<p class="hinge-question">The sets of data <span data-math="X">X</span> and <span data-math="Y">Y</span> are displayed in the histograms. Which statement is true?</p>
<div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div>
<div class="choices"><button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span><span data-math="X">X</span> has a larger mode and has a larger range.</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span><span data-math="X">X</span> has a larger mode and the ranges are the same.</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span>The modes are the same and <span data-math="Y">Y</span> has a larger range.</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span>The modes are the same and the ranges are the same.</span></button></div>
<div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly. On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div>
<div class="hinge-explanation" hidden>2. Mode(<span data-math="X">X</span>) = 9 and mode(<span data-math="Y">Y</span>) = 8. Range(<span data-math="X">X</span>) = 9 − 3 = 6; range(<span data-math="Y">Y</span>) = 11 − 5 = 6.</div>
</div>
```

::: notes
Treat this as a timed hinge with a 60-second default. Use the fist-on-chest, simultaneous 1–4 finger response routine. Timer expiry does not reveal the answer. Screen choices 1–4 correspond to the booklet’s A–D in the same order; question wording and option order are unchanged. Collect responses before using Reveal answer.

Correct choice 2. Choice 1 identifies the larger mode correctly but mistakes the ranges as unequal; choice 3 gets both comparisons wrong; choice 4 recognises the equal ranges but incorrectly claims equal modes.

Ready: ask students to name both modes and calculate both ranges from the horizontal-axis values.
Divided: have pairs compare maximum minus minimum for each dataset, then re-poll.
Reteach: point to the x-value beneath each tallest bar and the two extreme observed x-values, then re-poll before revealing.

Source: HSC Standard Mathematics 2011 Q11, as reproduced in the supplied booklet p. 47. Histograms redrawn from the supplied figure: X scores 3–9 frequencies 4,4,3,2,3,4,5; Y scores 5–11 frequencies 2,3,4,5,4,3,2. The original datasets and answer options are preserved. Note that shifting horizontal position alone does not change the range.
:::
